Process.Name: proc_DP00_OnEntered
Process.Description: **Purpose:** Handles truck arrival at dump point 00, implementing load balancing logic across two dump point paths (DP01 and DP02 routes) to minimize congestion. **Decide LoadedTruck:** Check if this is a loaded truck (Object.Is.obj_BatteryElectricTruck AND obj_BatteryElectricTruck.RideStation.Contents > 0) **Decide DP01&DP02 (Loaded):** Check if both dump paths are empty (all path segments have NumberWaiting == 0): **Decide DP01 (Loaded):** Check if only DP01 path is empty **SetNode DP23:** Route load entity to DP23 (obj_BatteryElectricTruck.RideStation.Contents.FirstItem.ModelEntity destination ← DP23) **SetNode DP13:** Route load entity to DP13 (obj_BatteryElectricTruck.RideStation.Contents.FirstItem.ModelEntity destination ← DP13) **Delay 1min:** Wait 1 minute before rechecking path availability **Decide DP01&DP02 (Empty):** Re-check if both paths are empty after delay **SetNode DP26:** Route empty truck destination to DP26 (obj_BatteryElectricTruck.DestinationNode ← DP26)

Step.Name: DP01
Step.Description: **Decide DP01 (Loaded):** Check if only DP01 path is empty

Step.Name: DP01&DP02
Step.Description: **Decide DP01&DP02 (Loaded):** Check if both dump paths are empty (all path segments have NumberWaiting == 0)

Step.Name: DP23
Step.Description: **SetNode DP23:** Route load entity to DP23 (obj_BatteryElectricTruck.RideStation.Contents.FirstItem.ModelEntity destination ← DP23)

Step.Name: DP13
Step.Description: **SetNode DP13:** Route load entity to DP13 (obj_BatteryElectricTruck.RideStation.Contents.FirstItem.ModelEntity destination ← DP13)

Step.Name: 1min
Step.Description: **Delay 1min:** Wait 1 minute before retrying station search, then return to step 1

Step.Name: LoadedTruck
Step.Description: **Decide LoadedTruck:** Check if this is a loaded truck (Object.Is.obj_BatteryElectricTruck AND obj_BatteryElectricTruck.RideStation.Contents > 0)

Step.Name: DP01&DP02
Step.Description: **Decide DP01&DP02 (Empty):** Re-check if both paths are empty after delay

Step.Name: DP26
Step.Description: **SetNode DP26:** Route empty truck destination to DP26 (obj_BatteryElectricTruck.DestinationNode ← DP26)
